description.text: Title:Tourism and Hotel Management, Taught in English, 4 years Degree Awarded:Bachelor of Management Profile: This program takes a broad view of tourism management, exploring the challenges relevant to a wide range of situations that managers and other professionals are likely to face.The program intensive but generalist approach prepares you for a wide range of careers in travel and tourism. Our graduates are often employed in official tourist organizations, transport providers, hotels, tour operating and travel agencies and government organizations. Education Objectives: You will develop your academic skills and knowledge, and learn approaches to management decision-making and critical evaluation. Importantly, the program has a practical focus on the managerial and strategic issues in the rapidly developing tourism industry. Job Prospects: Program alumni are found to have brilliant skills and sophisticated communication skills in Chinese, and are thus warmly welcomed by large multinational corporations, trade companies and financial departments inChina, as well as the home countries of the students. There are also some graduates working for family firms and are committed to their business relations withChina. This course provides the option to take a paid year internship & working in industry.Placement Internship students earn a allowance, typically over $2,000-6,000 per annum, and many are offered a permanent job ,typically over $5,000-75,000 with their host company when they graduate. Core Courses: Tourism Management Hospitality Management Traffic and Transportation Event Management Brand Management Strategic Marketing International Business Strategy Entrepreneurship Financial Accounting Human Recourse Management SICAS Care Team Members will lead the Chinese undergraduate and graduate students majored in Tourism and Hotel Management to act as mentors to help international students get settled down in Jinan and improve their proficiency in Chinese language. Project-based Learning: Project-based learning using CDIIO concepts is implemented throughout the curriculum. Precisely designed projects help our students to develop real-world problem-solving and communication skills, as well as teamwork spirit. Notes: Program commences only if 15 students are enrolled ; otherwise you can study Chinese Language/ Pre- University Program/ other bachelor programs.

duration.text: The Tourism and Hotel Management at Shandong Jiaotong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3333 USD/per year ￥ 24000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport 1). The first page of the passport (Indentity Page).With photo, passport number &expiration date and full name. 2). Two blank pages of the passport. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. Be in good health.
